name: MCP Server Kubernetes (Flux159)
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C7, C10; partly meets C5, C8; does not meet C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for mcp-server-kubernetes@4.2.3 names the repository `git+https://github.com/Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md` in the repository), and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 4.2.3 is dated 2026-11-13; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: 11 advisories are published in the repository's advisory list; each names a patched version at or below the latest release (4.2.3). Most recent: GHSA-6963-p4fp-2wxw (high, published 2026-10-02, patched in >= 4.1.1).

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Destructive operations are available unless non-destructive mode is set. Quoted: “You can run the server in a non-destructive mode that disables all destructive operations (delete pods, delete deployments, delete namespaces, etc.):”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The server uses the local kubeconfig. Quoted: “By default, the server loads kubeconfig from `~/.kube/config`.”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: OpenTelemetry integration is documented as off by default. Quoted: “This feature is disabled by default and can be enabled via environment variables or Helm configuration.”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`bun.lockb`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial; `SECURITY.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.32.0. Lower-bound version 1.32.0 of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm) was published on 2026-10-02, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
